Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on clolision with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness.
Initial examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, findings consistent
with the mechanism of injury described. Neurological screening, including reflexes and sensation in the upper and
lower extremities, was unremarkable. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar region is documented in the available
history. Conservative care was initiated, consisting of spinal mobilization, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching
instruction. Over the course of approximately thirty visits, treatment frequency and the range of services expanded,
with additional modalities added over time, although the presenting injury would typically be expetced to resolve on a
shorter course. Billing records reviewed for this summary show no duplicate or repeated charges. Current status is
improving, with ongoing pain reported at a lower intensity. Recommendation is continued home exercise and
reassessment at the next scheduled visit.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
